The '''Traveling Merchant''' is a [[Merchants (Pet Simulator 99)|merchant]] in [[Pet Simulator 99]]. It sells [[Items (Pet Simulator 99)|items]] for [[Currencies (Pet Simulator 99)|diamonds]] like the [[Items Merchant (Pet Simulator 99)|Items Merchant]] and the [[Advanced Merchant (Pet Simulator 99)|Advanced Merchant]], but spawns in a random area. The traveling merchant stays for 10 minutes. The Traveling Merchant's stock is shared between players on a server.

Upon arrival, a message will pop up displaying: "The traveling merchant has arrived!", and upon departure, displays: "The traveling merchant has departed."

It is unknown if the spawn time varies from server to server, or if there is a set time it appears.

== Respect ==
'''Respect''' is the leveling system for all the Merchants currently in the game. '''Respect''' is accumulated when the player purchases an item from the merchant and has a maximum level of 5. The player will unlock more slots to buy items from as the level of respect increases.

== Items for sale ==
The merchant will sell 6 different items in different quantities. 2 items do not require respect level to buy and the other 4 are unlocked with respect up until the maximum level of 5.
